summary: Nasher is a member of the Huntik Foundation Council. He currently quarters in Huntik International HQ in New York City. He is also in charge of the Foundation base in Tower of Nostradamus in Salon, France.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Nasher was present during the holographic Council called by a bedridden Metz to congratulate them on their efforts against the Organization. [Coming of Age]

Nasher alerted the Council after receiving an emergency call from his Agents in Tower of Nostradamus after they were taken prisoner by Wilder and his Organization team. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

Nasher was later present when Focauld Casterwill alerted Teien Casterwill that the Blood Spiral had found him, a matter Teien brought before the council. [The Casterwill Connection] Nasher was also present when Dante's team came before the council to discuss the Blood Spiral and were tasked with the mission Call of the Casterwill. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

Nasher joined the council on the longest night of the year to discuss plans to stop the activation of the Spiral Mark. [Words from Eathon] During the final battle at the Spiral Mark, he helped Clements and Billie. He stepped in to protect Billie and knocked out a Silent Soldier who was attacking her. [Dante's Return]

Following the defeat of The Betrayer, Nasher was seen with the council as they were joined by a new member, Dante Vale. [Dante's Return]

full_text:
Nasher is a member of the Huntik Foundation Council. He currently quarters in Huntik International HQ in New York City. He is also in charge of the Foundation base in Tower of Nostradamus in Salon, France.

== History ==
Nasher was present during the holographic Council called by a bedridden Metz to congratulate them on their efforts against the Organization. [Coming of Age]

Nasher alerted the Council after receiving an emergency call from his Agents in Tower of Nostradamus after they were taken prisoner by Wilder and his Organization team. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

Nasher was later present when Focauld Casterwill alerted Teien Casterwill that the Blood Spiral had found him, a matter Teien brought before the council. [The Casterwill Connection] Nasher was also present when Dante's team came before the council to discuss the Blood Spiral and were tasked with the mission Call of the Casterwill. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

Nasher joined the council on the longest night of the year to discuss plans to stop the activation of the Spiral Mark. [Words from Eathon] During the final battle at the Spiral Mark, he helped Clements and Billie. He stepped in to protect Billie and knocked out a Silent Soldier who was attacking her. [Dante's Return]

Following the defeat of The Betrayer, Nasher was seen with the council as they were joined by a new member, Dante Vale. [Dante's Return]

==Personality==
Nasher seems to be very protective of his subordinates. When they got attacked by the Organization, he seemed really concerned to bring help to them as soon as possible. [The Tower of Nostradamus] He is willing to save them no matter what the cost and even risks his life for them, such as when he personally protected them from the Blood Spiral. [Lok and the Betrayer]

He stepped in to protect Billie and knocked out a [[Silent Soldier]] who was attacking her. {{source|Dante's Return}}
